title: Pulse update follows rhythm plan instead of rediscovering strategy
query: A 30-minute pulse lane wakes up with a fresh rhythm plan and stale high-level ideas in chat history. What should it read and decide from?
reference_points: Reads the rhythm plan and horizon plan artifacts rather than relying on chat memory
Checks drift against the active task and rhythm plan
Does not rediscover horizon strategy during the fast pulse
Reconciles previous child outcomes before choosing a new action
Selects one bounded action arm or forced maintenance action
Records the decision and expected outputs in local automation state

title: Pulse update separates interval from action authority
query: The operator changes the pulse interval from 30 minutes to 4 hours for a pilot. What behavior should change, and what should remain controlled by policy?
reference_points: States that interval only changes wake timing
Keeps action authority, allowed arms, child-thread budget, and gates in policy
Does not infer broader execution permission from a slower interval
Still records rewards, decisions, and spawned-thread lineage
Supports piloting by changing cadence without changing skill logic
